description: A countdown that detonates at zero instead of resolving: a long flat plateau, one climb, the deepest valley placed right before the point of no return, then a final climb that never comes back down — ending at the track's loudest moment, loud and dark at once, with a tentative return to the home key landing as impact rather than resolution.
name: zero_day

sections.name: Intro
sections.notes: Cold open at -27.9dB, the quietest window in the track. Sparse, near-silence; build to ~-17dB by 0:30.

sections.name: First statement (F)
sections.notes: Long level plateau, mean -17.0dB. F center with third ambiguity (F min -> F maj key flip at 2:00 is mixture on a static root, not modulation). Hold the pressure flat — do not build yet.

sections.name: Hinge pocket
sections.notes: 13s dip. Darkest, narrowest timbre in the track (centroid 1178Hz at 3:10, ZCR 0.0397), RMS to -23.0dB. Darkness marks the direction change.

sections.name: Bb statement
sections.notes: Center moves to Bb (smuggled in: already a top-3 chroma pitch in the F sections). Plateau continues; brightest timbre in the track (centroid 3544Hz at 4:40). Let it ride.

sections.name: Climb
sections.notes: The only sustained rise in the first half: 30s means -14.6 -> -13.3 -> -13.2dB. Peak -0.5dB at 7:10, the loudest peak in the track — then cut it off, do not dwell.

sections.name: Valley
sections.notes: Deepest sustained passage (mean -21.0dB, min -23.7dB at 7:40), dark timbre (centroid 1454-2295Hz). The last quiet thing in the track. The tempo step lands at its end.

sections.name: Rebuild at 143.6
sections.notes: Tempo STEPS 136.0 -> 143.6 BPM at 8:00 (no ramp) as the valley ends; center moves to C minor. RMS mean -15.2dB and climbing. 143.6 is the closing track's tempo — the handoff is in the number.

sections.name: Final climb
sections.notes: 30s means -14.2 -> -13.6dB. No dips back to the valley — the track never returns to that level. Keep climbing.

sections.name: Finale (loud-dark ending)
sections.notes: Loudest section (mean -12.1dB, track-max -9.1dB RMS at 11:05) while the timbre darkens (centroid 2706 -> 1287Hz, ZCR floor 0.0243). Loud AND dark at once. Hard stop at the maximum — a stomp, not a fade. Tentative F-min return in the final window lands as impact, not resolution.

source_track: YOLO SNIPES - ZERO DAY (track 13 of INTERNALISM)
